ICYMI: A female protester was hurt on Monday night, November 17, after a drone fell on her head during the second day of the anti-corruption protest at the EDSA People Power Monument in Quezon City. 

The victim was promptly given medical attention after suffering a laceration.

The Quezon City Department of Public Order and Safety immediately confiscated the drone after the incident.

LEE JONG SUK FANMEETING IN MANILA CANCELED DUE TO RALLY

READ: Lee Jong Suk's Nov. 30 fan meeting at the Araneta Coliseum has been canceled due to the large-scale rally set on the same date, Korean entertainment agency Ace Factory announces.

"With the scheduled rally on the same date, this decision was made after careful consideration for the safety of the fans, the artist, and all related teams," Ace Factory says in a statement on Monday, Nov. 17.

It assures tickets will be refunded.

Several groups are set to hold another "Trillion Peso March" rally on Nov. 30 to protest the corruption in the government's flood control projects. | https://t.co/AuNWhQqswP intern PJ De Vera

📸 Ace Factory/Instagram
